# InterLayer_Coupling_Strength

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A parameter quantifying how strongly the infection state in one layer influences the infection probability in another layer of a multiplex network. Critical for understanding how information or signal propagation across different topological layers can be controlled or exploited in neuromorphic computing substrates.
